You’ve got a few reliable options in Kuwait—some local, some online:

## In Kuwait (easy + usually authentic)
- **Sephora Kuwait (online + stores)**: Carries multiple Korean brands (for example **Laneige**). ([sephora.me](https://www.sephora.me/kw-en/brands/neige/NEIGE?utm_source=openai))  
  Tip: Search the Sephora Kuwait site by brand name (Laneige, Innisfree, etc.) since the K‑beauty selection changes.

- **Wafi Cosmetics (local retailer)**: Listed by **COSRX** as a Kuwait stockist. ([cosrx.com](https://www.cosrx.com/pages/stores?q=uzlLyQf4&utm_source=openai))  

## Online that ships to Kuwait
- **iHerb (ships to Kuwait)**: Often has Korean skincare like **COSRX** and delivers to Kuwait with clear shipping thresholds/fees shown on their Kuwait shipping page. ([iherb.com](https://www.iherb.com/shipping/kw?utm_source=openai))  

## If you want Olive Young brands specifically
- **Olive Young Global doesn’t ship to Kuwait** (so you can’t order directly). ([global.oliveyoung.com](https://global.oliveyoung.com/?trk=nav_logo&utm_source=openai))  
- You’d need a **proxy/forwarding service** that buys from Olive Young and ships internationally (example: “Ships From Korea” offers an Olive Young buying service). ([shipsfromkorea.com](https://shipsfromkorea.com/stores/olive-young?utm_source=openai))  

If you tell me **which area you’re in (Kuwait City/Salmiya/etc.)** and **which brands** you want (e.g., COSRX, Beauty of Joseon, Round Lab), I can narrow it down to the best/fastest options and what to search for on each site.
